messages:
alex: Heads-up — my feature branch authz-refactor is CI red after I rebased onto main. Failing integration: session_store_test::expiration_rate_limit. Anyone free to eyeball? :sweat_smile:
ci-bot: CI pipeline #482 (authz-refactor) failed — shard 7/12. logs: https://ci.example.com/482
maria: @alex can you paste the failing stack? quick grep of logs helps :eyes:
alex: here are the last lines:
```
[ RUN      ] session_store_test.expiration_rate_limit
../../redwood/session_store_test.cc:132: Expected 0, got 1
  Error: token still valid after TTL
``` 
juan: re-running shard often nukes flakes, try `/ci rerun --shard 7` :shrug:
alex: running `/ci rerun 482 --shard 7` now
ci-bot: Re-run queued by alex — build 482.2 started
ci-bot: Build 482.2 completed — FAILED (same test)
maria: hmm same failure. Did the rebase bring in the session TTL change from 9f4a2b? @alex did you rebase with the migration commit? :thinking_face:
alex: yes, rebase included 9f4a2b (session: make default ttl 30s). I didn't expect tests to rely on 10s.
oliver: that explains it — tests assume shorter TTL. Might be better to mock clock in test or make test use injected TTL. Bisect could confirm which commit introduced the change.
priya: I can bisect this afternoon. @alex can you give the commit range (before/after main) and repro steps? I'll try to run locally.
alex: range: main@c1a2b3..authz-refactor@HEAD. Local repro steps:
```
make test-integration
pytest tests/integration/session_store_test.py::test_expiration_rate_limit -k shard7
``` 
priya: thanks — I'll try now. If I can reproduce, I'll open a quick PR to mock time in the test and link here.
priya: reproduced locally, failing in same assertion. quick fix: in test set ttl = 30 or mock time; making a small test-only patch now.
alex: :thumbsup: please cc me. I'll hold off merging anything to main until CI stabilizes.
ci-bot: Quick PR #789 opened by priya: test(session): mock clock for expiration test — CI triggered
ci-bot: PR 789: all checks passed ✅
priya: landed the fix to authz-refactor and merged. can someone trigger full shard rerun? Thanks!
alex: triggered `/ci rerun 482 --all` — fingers crossed
ci-bot: Build 482.3 started
ci-bot: Build 482.3 completed — SUCCESS :tada:
alex: nice, green now. leaving branch open but will rebase again and keep an eye. Filing a follow-up to avoid fragile TTL assumptions: https://issues.example.com/RED-234
maria: nice work team. marking this resolved for now. :heavy_check_mark:
